say:0:1421301001:0.text: General Hogan has sent you <style="highlight">a letter</style>. It is likely about the investigation report on Brimstone Village.
say:0:1421301001:0.source_cn: 霍根将军寄来了<style=highlight>一封信...
say:0:1421301001:0.male: General Hogan has sent you <style="highlight">a letter</style>. It is likely about the investigation report on Brimstone Village.
say:0:1421301001:0.female: General Hogan has sent you <style="highlight">a letter</style>. It is likely about the investigation report on Brimstone Village.

say:1:1421301002:0.text: Talk to <style="highlight">Zanie</style> about it. She has been around the village lately.
say:1:1421301002:0.male: Talk to <style="highlight">Zanie</style> about it. She has been around the village lately.
say:1:1421301002:0.female: Talk to <style="highlight">Zanie</style> about it. She has been around the village lately.

say:0:1421302001:0.text: Next, the village should do this...

say:1:1421303001:1.text: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Judging from the expression on your face, you have something serious to tell me...
say:1:1421303001:1.male: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Judging from the expression on your face, you have something serious to tell me...
say:1:1421303001:1.female: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Judging from the expression on your face, you have something serious to tell me...

choice_prompt:2:1421303001.text: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Judging from the expression on your face, you have something serious to tell me...
choice_prompt:2:1421303001.source_cn: 怎么了，<style=stress><player_name></style>？看你的表情，好像找我有事……
choice_prompt:2:1421303001.male: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Judging from the expression on your face, you have something serious to tell me...
choice_prompt:2:1421303001.female: What's going on, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Judging from the expression on your face, you have something serious to tell me...

say:3:1421303002:1.text: Oh, from your injured friend? I hope he's recovered from everything he went through.
say:3:1421303002:1.source_cn: 哦？是你那位受伤的同伴吧，他身体恢复了吗？
say:3:1421303002:1.male: Oh, from your injured friend? I hope he's recovered from everything he went through.
say:3:1421303002:1.female: Oh, from your injured friend? I hope he's recovered from everything he went through.

say:4:1421303003:1.text: Wait, there's a frown on your face again... Let me guess. The letter has something to do with the village.
say:4:1421303003:1.source_cn: 看你的表情，难道那封信与我们这边有关？
say:4:1421303003:1.male: Wait, there's a frown on your face again... Let me guess. The letter has something to do with the village.
say:4:1421303003:1.female: Wait, there's a frown on your face again... Let me guess. The letter has something to do with the village.

say:6:1421303005:1.text: General Hogan's letter brings good news. He's recovering. Also, the dwarven rebellion and the appearance of the Essail haven't caused as much chaos as he thought they would.
say:6:1421303005:1.source_cn: 正如信中所写的，霍根将军带来了些许好消息：他的身体恢复...

say:7:1421303006:1.text: However, the letter mentions a predicament that Brimstone Village now faces. Sal'thorin has taken the initiative and contacted the outside world. They no longer need the village as an intermediary.
say:7:1421303006:1.source_cn: 但是，除此之外，信中辛辣地指出了深岩村面临的现状：萨洛...

say:8:1421303007:1.text: With the disappearance of echorite, it's no longer possible to forge high-quality weapons as before. Also, the rebellion caused mistrust for those in charge of Brimstone Village.
say:8:1421303007:1.source_cn: 深岩晶消失，无法再像以前一样铸造出高质量的武器；同时，...

say:9:1421303008:1.text: With no <style="highlight">value</style> and <style="highlight">trust</style>, there is no meaning in an alliance between the Lightbearer Empire and Brimstone Village.

say:10:1421303009:1.text: The general has warned that the Empire may once again send a secret envoy to investigate the situation. Another crisis may be on its way...
say:10:1421303009:1.source_cn: 将军警告我们，不久之后，帝国可能会派遣<style=h...

say:12:1421303010:1.text: Another envoy of the Empire... Depending on travel conditions, they could be here in a few months.
say:12:1421303010:1.source_cn: 帝国的密使啊……如果脚程够快，没几个月应该就会到来了。

say:13:1421303011:1.text: If we can't give a satisfactory answer to this secret envoy, the village is done for. What's going to happen to everyone?
say:13:1421303011:1.source_cn: 如果没法让这位密使大人满意的话……村子肯定是完了，村里...

choice_prompt:14:1421303011.text: If we can't give a satisfactory answer to this secret envoy, the village is done for. What's going to happen to everyone?
choice_prompt:14:1421303011.source_cn: 如果没法让这位密使大人满意的话……村子肯定是完了，村里留下的这些倒霉蛋会怎么办？

say:15:1421303012:1.text: Well, yeah, I know that, but things are going to get tough for everyone.
say:15:1421303012:1.source_cn: 但多多少少会再吃点苦头吧，我知道的。

say:16:1421303015:1.text: Alright, we have to restore the village as fast as we can and show something valuable that will satisfy the envoy.
say:16:1421303015:1.source_cn: 所以，我们得在尽量短的时间里，让村子重新振作起来，展现...

choice_prompt:17:1421303015.text: Alright, we have to restore the village as fast as we can and show something valuable that will satisfy the envoy.
choice_prompt:17:1421303015.source_cn: 所以，我们得在尽量短的时间里，让村子重新振作起来，展现出能让密使满意的东西。

say:18:1421303016:1.text: Well, trust is all about loyalty. Eldric's been arrested, and the remaining folks can be taught what loyalty means.
say:18:1421303016:1.source_cn: 信任，换言之也就是忠诚。弗林已经被逮捕了，剩余的人暂且...

say:19:1421303017:1.text: But without the dragon eggs... Without echorite, what does Brimstone Village really have?
say:19:1421303017:1.source_cn: 但失去了龙蛋——也就是深岩晶的深岩村，还能有什么不同的...

choice:14:0:1.text: Their lives won't be in danger.
choice:14:0:1.male: Their lives won't be in danger.
choice:14:0:1.female: Their lives won't be in danger.

say:21:1421303013:1.text: Yes, scatter everyone to the winds! Force them out of their homes! That'll solve the problem!
say:21:1421303013:1.source_cn: 就是把人打散了，远离家乡，送到其他的矮人矿山或村庄去吧……

say:22:1421303014:1.text: *Sigh*... We dwarves love this land. It's been our home for generations. This is a punishment worse than death...
say:22:1421303014:1.source_cn: 对大部分热爱故乡的矮人来说，这可是比肉体折磨更生不如死...

choice:2:0:1.text: Got a letter from General Hogan.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我收到了霍根将军的信
choice:2:0:1.male: Got a letter from General Hogan.
choice:2:0:1.female: Got a letter from General Hogan.

say:23:1421303004:1.text: Well, I know you never do anything without reason, so just tell me. Oh, you have that frown on your face again.
say:23:1421303004:1.source_cn: 我知道你向来不会做无用的事，什么事？看你表情有些凝重啊。
say:23:1421303004:1.male: Well, I know you never do anything without reason, so just tell me. Oh, you have that frown on your face again.
say:23:1421303004:1.female: Well, I know you never do anything without reason, so just tell me. Oh, you have that frown on your face again.

choice:2:1:2.text: I need to tell you something.
choice:2:1:2.male: I need to tell you something.
choice:2:1:2.female: I need to tell you something.

say:0:1421304001:0.text: Let's go to the mine first. Maybe we can find a substitute for the mineral.
say:0:1421304001:0.source_cn: 先去矿洞看看，说不定能找到矿产的替代品。
say:0:1421304001:0.male: Let's go to the mine first. Maybe we can find a substitute for the mineral.
say:0:1421304001:0.female: Let's go to the mine first. Maybe we can find a substitute for the mineral.

say:0:1421306001:0.text: Why are there only a few people here? And they're all listless and drunk...
say:0:1421306001:0.source_cn: 这里怎么就剩这么几个人了，还没精打采的……还喝了酒？
say:0:1421306001:0.male: Why are there only a few people here? And they're all listless and drunk...
say:0:1421306001:0.female: Why are there only a few people here? And they're all listless and drunk...

say:2:1421307001:1.text: Hey! Are you a miner here? Why are you drinking at a time like this?
say:2:1421307001:1.source_cn: 喂，你是这里的矿工吗？怎么在宝贵的矿洞里喝酒？

say:3:1421307002:1.text: Don't bother me. Just get me another drink!
say:3:1421307002:1.source_cn: 别、别打扰我，我要，我要喝酒！

say:4:1421307003:1.text: What's a miner to do when there's no mine? Duh! We drink!
say:4:1421307003:1.source_cn: 矿洞……什么宝贵的矿洞……都没有矿了，不就是个——嗝！

say:5:1421307004:1.text: We drink, sleep, and drink again!

choice_prompt:6:1421307004.text: We drink, sleep, and drink again!

say:7:1421307005:1.text: Judging from the rock conditions, it doesn't seem to be completely dry. At least, there should be a lot of iron ore.
say:7:1421307005:1.source_cn: 看矿洞的岩层状况，不太像完全枯竭才对，至少铁矿应该有不少。

say:8:1421307007:1.text: Let's check the vein for ore and see if there's any problem with the mine.
say:8:1421307007:1.source_cn: 我们先调查下周围的矿脉，看看是不是矿洞出了什么问题吧。

say:10:1421307006:1.text: Even if we dwarves love drinking, we would never get drunk in a beautiful mine like this!
say:10:1421307006:1.source_cn: 矮人就算好酒，也不会在矿洞这样美好的地方喝醉！

say:1:1421308001:1.text: Well, the ore vein looks fine to me.
say:1:1421308001:1.source_cn: 唔，矿石没有受到太大的影响啊。

say:2:1421308002:1.text: I'm guessing, in the past, this place was probably used as a cover for inspectors, and the extent of mining was limited. Just by walking around, I can see exposed iron ore.
say:2:1421308002:1.source_cn: 以前大概只是拿这里当幌子，开采程度很有限，光是这么绕一...

say:3:1421308003:1.text: That guy's probably just lazy and doesn't want to work.
say:3:1421308003:1.source_cn: 他这副样子，估计就是好吃懒做，不想干活！

choice_prompt:4:1421308003.text: That guy's probably just lazy and doesn't want to work.
choice_prompt:4:1421308003.source_cn: 他这副样子，估计就是好吃懒做，不想干活！

say:5:1421308004:1.text: What for? Ask him where the nearest tavern is? C'mon, that kind of stonesucker is beyond saving.
say:5:1421308004:1.source_cn: 你该不会要给他找酒吧？这种在矿洞里喝醉的醉鬼可是无药可救！
say:5:1421308004:1.male: What for? Ask him where the nearest tavern is? C'mon, that kind of stonesucker is beyond saving.
say:5:1421308004:1.female: What for? Ask him where the nearest tavern is? C'mon, that kind of stonesucker is beyond saving.

choice_prompt:6:1421308004.text: What for? Ask him where the nearest tavern is? C'mon, that kind of stonesucker is beyond saving.
choice_prompt:6:1421308004.source_cn: 你该不会要给他找酒吧？这种在矿洞里喝醉的醉鬼可是无药可救！
choice_prompt:6:1421308004.male: What for? Ask him where the nearest tavern is? C'mon, that kind of stonesucker is beyond saving.
choice_prompt:6:1421308004.female: What for? Ask him where the nearest tavern is? C'mon, that kind of stonesucker is beyond saving.

say:7:1421308005:1.text: You know you're pretty even-tempered. Alright, we'll do it your way.
say:7:1421308005:1.source_cn: 哼，你真是好脾气，算了算了，听你的。
say:7:1421308005:1.male: You know you're pretty even-tempered. Alright, we'll do it your way.
say:7:1421308005:1.female: You know you're pretty even-tempered. Alright, we'll do it your way.

say:8:1421308006:1.text: Drinks aren't allowed in the mine. But if you can't do without it, just slip it into one of those empty boxes...
say:8:1421308006:1.source_cn: 下矿通常是不让带酒的，如果要带，多半是找个空箱子随便塞...

say:9:1421308007:1.text: Oh, Helthor's beard! He went through a lot of boxes!
say:9:1421308007:1.source_cn: 赫托在下！怎么连箱子都乱成这个样子！

choice:4:0:1.text: Let's go back and ask him.
choice:4:0:1.male: Let's go back and ask him.
choice:4:0:1.female: Let's go back and ask him.

say:2:1421309001:1.text: *Chugging noises*... Ha! That's some good stuff!
say:2:1421309001:1.source_cn: 咕嘟咕嘟咕嘟……酒……好酒，哈哈哈，好酒！

say:3:1421309002:1.text: Alright, now that you've had something to drink, answer a few of questions of ours.
say:3:1421309002:1.source_cn: 行了！现在喝到酒了，能回答我们的问题了吧？

say:4:1421309003:1.text: It's the middle of the day, and you're not working. Instead, you're in this beautiful mine, drinking since morning. What's your problem? You an alcoholic or something?
say:4:1421309003:1.source_cn: 大白天的，你不去干活，还在宝贵的矿洞里酗酒，是想干什么！

say:5:1421309004:1.text: What...? I ain't an alcoholic! I'm... I'm just sad! For the echorite!
say:5:1421309004:1.source_cn: 酗……酗酒？我不是酗酒！我这是……哀、哀悼！为了宝贵的...

say:6:1421309005:1.text: You have no idea, little lass. Have you ever seen echorite up close?! It's like... a barrel of century-old wine! It's magical... Touching it even makes your soul relax...
say:6:1421309005:1.source_cn: 小丫头，你没见过深岩晶吧？它就像是，百年的陈酿！抚摸着...

say:7:1421309006:1.text: Compared to that, the iron ore here is like the wine you gave me. No different from mole manure!
say:7:1421309006:1.source_cn: 相比之下，这里的铁矿，那就像是，你们拿给我的这、这种酒...

say:8:1421309007:1.text: You say it's disgusting, so why are you drinking...?
say:8:1421309007:1.source_cn: 你自己说自己喝的东西，都不嫌恶心吗……

say:9:1421309008:1.text: *Bitter laugh*... It can't be compared to the pain of losing our echorite...
say:9:1421309008:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，比不上失去深岩晶的痛苦……

say:10:1421309009:1.text: Once you've held it in your hands, all other ores are inferior... Inferior!
say:10:1421309009:1.source_cn: 只要尝试过深岩晶，其他所有的，一切矿石，都是劣等品……

choice_prompt:11:1421309009.text: Once you've held it in your hands, all other ores are inferior... Inferior!
choice_prompt:11:1421309009.source_cn: 只要尝试过深岩晶，其他所有的，一切矿石，都是劣等品……

say:12:1421309010:1.text: There are plenty of miners like him down here. They live for this work, you know? And the echorite... well, its quality was unmatched. Nothing else comes close.
say:12:1421309010:1.source_cn: ……这个人，唉。矮人中有很多像他一样，深爱着矿石，而深...

say:13:1421309011:1.text: If I didn't know the truth behind it, I would be addicted to it too.
say:13:1421309011:1.source_cn: 如果不是我知道了真相，恐怕我也会沉迷于此吧。

say:0:1421310001:0.text: Let's keep looking around the mine. Maybe we will discover something else.
say:0:1421310001:0.source_cn: 继续调查下矿洞吧，看看有没有新的发现。
say:0:1421310001:0.male: Let's keep looking around the mine. Maybe we will discover something else.
say:0:1421310001:0.female: Let's keep looking around the mine. Maybe we will discover something else.

say:0:1421311001:0.text: A blue ore... It's called celestrite, right? Let's check it out.
say:0:1421311001:0.source_cn: 蓝色的矿石？是叫天青矿的吧……调查下看看……
say:0:1421311001:0.male: A blue ore... It's called celestrite, right? Let's check it out.
say:0:1421311001:0.female: A blue ore... It's called celestrite, right? Let's check it out.

say:1:1421312001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's up? You've been standing there a while.
say:1:1421312001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's up? You've been standing there a while.
say:1:1421312001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's up? You've been standing there a while.

choice_prompt:2:1421312001.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's up? You've been standing there a while.
choice_prompt:2:1421312001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，怎么了？我看你在这停留了好久了。
choice_prompt:2:1421312001.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's up? You've been standing there a while.
choice_prompt:2:1421312001.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's up? You've been standing there a while.

say:3:1421312002:1.text: Oh yes, I know this vein. It's a special ore that's exclusive to this mine.
say:3:1421312002:1.source_cn: 啊，我知道这个，应该是这矿洞里专门出产的特殊矿脉。

say:4:1421312004:1.text: I remember seeing ore before when I was a child... It left a deep impression in me.
say:4:1421312004:1.source_cn: 我感觉曾经见过类似的矿，在我小时候……那会儿印象还挺深的。

say:5:1421312005:1.text: But to be honest, all ores look similar. Some may look and feel alike but have vastly different effects.
say:5:1421312005:1.source_cn: 但矿石这种东西，说实话长得都差不多，很多看起来一模一样...

choice_prompt:6:1421312005.text: But to be honest, all ores look similar. Some may look and feel alike but have vastly different effects.
choice_prompt:6:1421312005.source_cn: 但矿石这种东西，说实话长得都差不多，很多看起来一模一样的东西效果天差地别。

say:7:1421312006:1.text: Mages really are amateurs! Let me set you straight. My expertise lies in mechanical research and development. I only specialize in materials that involve my projects.
say:7:1421312006:1.source_cn: 真是，魔法师就是外行！告诉你，我的专业是机械研发，对材...
say:7:1421312006:1.male: Mages really are amateurs! Let me set you straight. My expertise lies in mechanical research and development. I only specialize in materials that involve my projects.
say:7:1421312006:1.female: Mages really are amateurs! Let me set you straight. My expertise lies in mechanical research and development. I only specialize in materials that involve my projects.

say:8:1421312007:1.text: The rest of these ores and minerals I can only judge based on my instincts as a dwarf and my basic education.
say:8:1421312007:1.source_cn: 其余矿产什么的，包括这里剩余的矿石，只能说是靠我作为矮...

say:9:1421312008:1.text: Just like iron ore and copper ore, anyone can tell what they are just by looking, right? But I'm no expert when it comes to minerals, so that's about as far as my knowledge goes.
say:9:1421312008:1.source_cn: 就像铁矿铜矿什么的，是个人走过去都能判断吧？对我没有专...

choice_prompt:10:1421312008.text: Just like iron ore and copper ore, anyone can tell what they are just by looking, right? But I'm no expert when it comes to minerals, so that's about as far as my knowledge goes.
choice_prompt:10:1421312008.source_cn: 就像铁矿铜矿什么的，是个人走过去都能判断吧？对我没有专精的矿产，我也就了解到这个程度。

say:11:1421312009:1.text: See! Aren't you a mage? Shouldn't you know everything? *Hmph*... Anyway, let's find some miners who work with celestrite.
say:11:1421312009:1.source_cn: 你是魔法师嘛。唔，所以，这里的天青矿，得再找找在这边的...
say:11:1421312009:1.male: See! Aren't you a mage? Shouldn't you know everything? *Hmph*... Anyway, let's find some miners who work with celestrite.
say:11:1421312009:1.female: See! Aren't you a mage? Shouldn't you know everything? *Hmph*... Anyway, let's find some miners who work with celestrite.

say:12:1421312010:1.text: I don't want to believe everyone is just drowning in their sorrows like that rockknobber over there. Hey, wait!
say:12:1421312010:1.source_cn: 我就不信，所有人都跟那个酒鬼一样哭天抢地的——等等。

say:14:1421312011:0.text: I think someone is calling for help!
say:14:1421312011:0.source_cn: 你有没有听到那边有呼救声？！

choice:6:1:2.text: How do you not know about this ore?
choice:6:1:2.male: How do you not know about this ore?
choice:6:1:2.female: How do you not know about this ore?

say:16:1421312003:1.text: It's unique to the mine here.
say:16:1421312003:1.source_cn: 印象是有，应该是这里特有的矿产来着。

choice:2:1:2.text: What do you think about this ore?
choice:2:1:2.male: What do you think about this ore?
choice:2:1:2.female: What do you think about this ore?

say:0:1421314001:0.text: There are wild beasts in the mine! This is crazy!
say:0:1421314001:0.source_cn: 矿洞内居然有野兽！这简直不可想象！

say:2:1421315001:1.text: Thank you guys! I never expected to get attacked in the mines...
say:2:1421315001:1.source_cn: 多、多亏你们，我完全没想到会在矿洞里遇到袭击……

say:3:1421315002:1.text: Wait, aren't you supposed to be on patrol? Where are your weapons and equipment?
say:3:1421315002:1.source_cn: 你是负责巡逻的吧？你的武器装备呢？

say:4:1421315003:1.text: My weapon was too heavy so... I left it outside. I mean, I never expected to use it!
say:4:1421315003:1.source_cn: 那个太沉了，我就放在外头了……毕竟现在这边也没什么人用了啊！

say:5:1421315004:1.text: A few days ago, there were quite a few youngsters coming and going. They might've thought it was an amusement park or something. I never expect it to be this dangerous…

say:14:1421315013:1.text: This ore is special, no doubt, but we've always had echorite to focus on, so we never mined it much. Now that there's even less of it, it's hardly worth the effort.

say:2:1421330002:1.text: The village is short of manpower right now, so we don't have guards to spare. I explicitly warned you not to go to remote areas and to stay together.
say:2:1421330002:1.source_cn: 现在村子防守人力不足，不是跟你们说过别到偏远地方，多人...

say:3:1421330003:1.source_cn: 我、我们一起行动了……呜呜。

say:4:1421330004:1.text: Oh, well, good. Alright, stand up and stop looking away. I want to see who I'm dealing with. Nuen, Sanger, and Pama?! It's the three of you?
say:4:1421330004:1.source_cn: 哦，对，没错，一起行动是吧？让我看看，桑果！努安！琶！...

say:6:1421330005:1.text: The three youngsters nod nervously, and Pama even lets out a sob, clearly overwhelmed by fear.
say:6:1421330005:1.source_cn: 三个人紧张地点头，名叫琶的那个甚至吓得啜泣了起来。

say:7:1421330006:1.text: Hyla stares sternly at the people in front of her. Her brows gradually furrow. Then, she pulls us aside to talk.
say:7:1421330006:1.source_cn: 海拉严厉地扫视着眼前的几个人，眉头逐渐紧锁，随后，她拉...

say:9:1421330007:1.text: Is something wrong? What's the story with these three kids?
say:9:1421330007:1.source_cn: 怎么了？这三个孩子有什么问题？

say:10:1421330008:1.text: I don't mean to make excuses for them, but based on what I know, these three are considered the most honest and well-behaved of the bunch.
say:10:1421330008:1.source_cn: 我不是要替他们开脱，但以我对村民的了解，他们三个都是那...

say:11:1421330009:1.source_cn: 老实到会被欺负的那种？

say:12:1421330010:1.text: Yes, I'm glad you understand. I know the kind of kids who wrote that kind of stuff, but I can't pinpoint who did it.
say:12:1421330010:1.source_cn: 是，你懂我意思就好，我大概知道那几个写下那种东西的家伙...

choice_prompt:13:1421330010.text: Yes, I'm glad you understand. I know the kind of kids who wrote that kind of stuff, but I can't pinpoint who did it.
choice_prompt:13:1421330010.source_cn: 是，你懂我意思就好，我大概知道那几个写下那种东西的家伙，只是没法确定到底是谁。

say:14:1421330011:1.text: Yes, I agree. It feels like this was planned otherwise we wouldn't have found their footprints.
say:14:1421330011:1.source_cn: 嗯，我明白，我感觉他们也是被教唆了，要不然也不会在这里...

say:16:1421330013:1.text: You three! Why are you here? Don't you dare hide anything from us! Do you have a secret base nearby or something?
say:16:1421330013:1.source_cn: 所以，你们为什么来这里？别瞒我，你们是不是在附近有什么...

say:17:1421330014:1.text: Actually... yes... it's not that far away but...

say:18:1421330015:1.text: No more excuses! Are you gathering at that abandoned patrol area?
say:18:1421330015:1.source_cn: 不准狡辩！老实说，是不是用了那个废弃的巡视点？你们在那...

say:20:1421330017:1.text: Take us there now! We'll decide if you did anything wrong!
say:20:1421330017:1.source_cn: 带我们去看看！你们到底干没干什么，得我们判断才行！

choice:13:0:1.text: They still may be connected to this.
choice:13:0:1.male: They still may be connected to this.
choice:13:0:1.female: They still may be connected to this.

say:22:1421330012:1.text: Yes, the tracks lead all the way here, but there's nothing here. I'm afraid they may have other plans.
say:22:1421330012:1.source_cn: 是的，足迹一直通到这里，但这什么都没有，恐怕他们另有打算。

say:0:1421332001:0.text: Let's split up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We'll find clues faster that way.
say:0:1421332001:0.male: Let's split up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We'll find clues faster that way.
say:0:1421332001:0.female: Let's split up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We'll find clues faster that way.

say:2:1421335001:1.text: *Sigh*… Compared to these proposals and views, Eldric seems almost loyal and moderate…
say:2:1421335001:1.source_cn: 嘶……这倡议书，这观点，跟她一比，弗林都显得忠诚温和了……

choice_prompt:3:1421335001.text: *Sigh*… Compared to these proposals and views, Eldric seems almost loyal and moderate…
choice_prompt:3:1421335001.source_cn: 嘶……这倡议书，这观点，跟她一比，弗林都显得忠诚温和了……

say:4:1421335002:1.text: I thought that most young people just had their heads in the clouds. I didn't expect them to be so radical.
say:4:1421335002:1.source_cn: 我原本以为年轻人只是喜欢想象，没想到会这么激进。

say:5:1421335004:1.text: <style="highlight">This leader named Inna</style>... Hyla, you said she was the chief troublemaker, right?

say:6:1421335005:1.text:
...
If it's really Inna, then she's more than just a simple troublemaker.
say:6:1421335005:1.source_cn: …………\n如果是伊娜，那她可不止是刺头那么简单。

say:7:1421335006:1.text: She's actually Eldric's granddaughter, but that's not that important. What is important is how rebellious she's become.
say:7:1421335006:1.source_cn: 她是弗林的孙女，但这其实影响不大，她有多叛逆，这里也写...

say:8:1421335007:1.text: Both she and her grandfather each embarked on different paths of rebellion. That's a fact.
say:8:1421335007:1.source_cn: 但这也不影响她和她祖父各自走上了不同的反叛道路啊。

say:9:1421335008:1.text: Listen, she may be a little radical, but it's not a hard problem to fix.
say:9:1421335008:1.source_cn: 听我说，只是态度激进一些，这并不是最棘手的问题。

say:10:1421335009:1.text: Inna has always been rebellious since she was a very young child. Even Eldric was a little afraid of her, so he always kept her close and made sure she didn't do anything too problematic.
say:10:1421335009:1.source_cn: 伊娜从小到大就一直很叛逆，连弗林都害怕她，所以一直都控...

say:11:1421335010:1.text: No matter how rebellious a kid gets, there's no need to be afraid of them. Especially a big guy like Eldric had nothing to fear unless there was something special about her.
say:11:1421335010:1.source_cn: 但，如果这孩子没有什么天分的话，再怎么激进，也不必特意...

say:12:1421335011:1.text: Very shrewd of you to notice that. Inna is some kind of <style="highlight">prodigy</style>... a genius...
say:12:1421335011:1.source_cn: 你很敏锐，正是如此。伊娜是我见过的——<style=h...

say:13:1421335012:1.text: She practically grew up in the workshop, tinkering with gears and wrenches, and watching the production line in action.
say:13:1421335012:1.source_cn: 她从小几乎在工坊里，摸着齿轮和扳手，看着生产线长大的。

say:14:1421335013:1.text: She masters new skills quickly and is willing to take the time to study them in depth. Her designs are daring and innovative. She's also meticulous and cautious when it comes to implementation.
say:14:1421335013:1.source_cn: 无论学什么都一点就通，也愿意耐下性子去深入研究；做设计...

say:15:1421335014:1.text: I have to admit that when it comes to invention, she has an <style="highlight">intuition</style> like no other.
say:15:1421335014:1.source_cn: 她在发明创造上，我不得不承认，甚至可以说是有一种<st...

say:16:1421335015:1.text: Honestly, her research and ideas have steered me in the right direction more than once when I was stuck on a project. I'm almost embarrassed to admit I am inferior to her designs.
say:16:1421335015:1.source_cn: 事实上，我走入困境时，好几次是她的研究和思路为我打开方...

say:17:1421335016:1.text: Radical ideology, technical expertise, and naturally talented...
say:17:1421335016:1.source_cn: 思想激进，唯矮人与技术至上，也有相应的能力……

choice_prompt:18:1421335016.text: Radical ideology, technical expertise, and naturally talented...
choice_prompt:18:1421335016.source_cn: 思想激进，唯矮人与技术至上，也有相应的能力……

say:19:1421335017:1.text: Yes, I agree. If a prodigy like Inna, she could probably do many things that I couldn't do.
say:19:1421335017:1.source_cn: 正是如此。我做不到的事，如果是伊娜这样的天才，那就无法...

say:20:1421335018:1.text: Then, we can't just leave this problem alone. This camp should just be a temporary gathering place for them.
say:20:1421335018:1.source_cn: 那就不能放任不管了，这个营地应该只是他们临时聚会的场所。

say:21:1421335019:1.text: I think these kids should know where Inna is.
say:21:1421335019:1.source_cn: 伊娜的去向，恐怕这些孩子多多少少会知道些什么。

choice:18:1:2.text: She may be able to reproduce it.
choice:18:1:2.male: She may be able to reproduce it.
choice:18:1:2.female: She may be able to reproduce it.

say:23:1421335003:1.text: Yes, that's right. If this manifesto is seen with Eldric's writings, the whole thing would look like a serious conspiracy. The village would be doomed.
say:23:1421335003:1.source_cn: 没错，这份纲领送上去，跟弗林的一起，可是相得益彰，相映...

choice:3:1:2.text: We need to compare the writing.
choice:3:1:2.male: We need to compare the writing.
choice:3:1:2.female: We need to compare the writing.

say:1:1421336001:1.source_cn: 我们绝不会出卖伟大的伊娜！

choice_prompt:2:1421336001.source_cn: 我们绝不会出卖伟大的伊娜！

say:3:1421336002:1.text: You better believe it! We may not be the smartest bunch, but our hearts are noble!
say:3:1421336002:1.source_cn: 你明白就好，我们虽然不聪明，但我们品质高尚！
say:3:1421336002:1.male: You better believe it! We may not be the smartest bunch, but our hearts are noble!
say:3:1421336002:1.female: You better believe it! We may not be the smartest bunch, but our hearts are noble!

say:4:1421336004:1.text: Inna has a plan for us! All of us!
say:4:1421336004:1.source_cn: 总之，伊娜领袖自有她自己的打算！

choice_prompt:5:1421336004.text: Inna has a plan for us! All of us!
choice_prompt:5:1421336004.source_cn: 总之，伊娜领袖自有她自己的打算！

say:6:1421336005:1.text: It's to revive the Ironheart Dominion and restore the glory of our ancient technologies!
say:6:1421336005:1.source_cn: 就是复兴钢心帝国，重现古代技术的荣光！

say:7:1421336007:1.text: Inna can do anything! She can accomplish this as well!
say:7:1421336007:1.source_cn: 伊娜无论做什么都做得很好，她绝对能办到的！

choice_prompt:8:1421336007.text: Inna can do anything! She can accomplish this as well!
choice_prompt:8:1421336007.source_cn: 伊娜无论做什么都做得很好，她绝对能办到的！

say:9:1421336008:1.text: Yes, with Inna by our side, no dream is out of reach!
say:9:1421336008:1.source_cn: 那当然，有伊娜在，无论什么梦想都不会遥不可及！

say:10:1421336010:1.text: We all have our own jobs too!
say:10:1421336010:1.source_cn: 总之，我们也有自己的工作！

choice_prompt:11:1421336010.text: We all have our own jobs too!
choice_prompt:11:1421336010.source_cn: 总之，我们也有自己的工作！

say:12:1421336011:1.text: Yes, there are some who have good grades and are smarter than us... but we are the most loyal!
say:12:1421336011:1.source_cn: 有是有，成绩好的，聪明的……但，但我们也很忠诚！

say:13:1421336014:1.text: We'll never betray Inna! We'll follow her to the end!
say:13:1421336014:1.source_cn: 总之，我们一定会跟随伊娜，绝不会出卖她！

choice_prompt:14:1421336014.text: We'll never betray Inna! We'll follow her to the end!
choice_prompt:14:1421336014.source_cn: 总之，我们一定会跟随伊娜，绝不会出卖她！

say:15:1421336015:1.text: We know everything about her plans!
say:15:1421336015:1.source_cn: 我们当然知道领袖的打算！

say:17:1421336012:1.source_cn: 呃，这个，这个……反正，我们绝对不会说的！

choice:11:1:2.text: Do you know where she is?
choice:11:1:2.male: Do you know where she is?
choice:11:1:2.female: Do you know where she is?

say:18:1421336013:1.text: We know a lot, okay? A lot of stuff...
say:18:1421336013:1.source_cn: 我们，我们知道她很多事！反正，反正……

choice:11:2:3.text: Any information you can give us?
choice:11:2:3.male: Any information you can give us?
choice:11:2:3.female: Any information you can give us?

say:19:1421336009:1.text: Uh... W-we can help out with errands and stuff...
say:19:1421336009:1.source_cn: 呃，我们，我们，我们至少能跑跑腿，帮帮忙……

choice:8:1:2.text: What are you all supposed to do?
choice:8:1:2.male: What are you all supposed to do?
choice:8:1:2.female: What are you all supposed to do?

say:20:1421336006:1.text: That's right! We're going to recreate the technologies of the Ironheart Dominion, and we dwarves will once again stand tall in Esperia!
say:20:1421336006:1.source_cn: 没错！我们要重现钢心帝国的技术与风采，让矮人屹立世间！

choice:2:0:1.text: You're all quite loyal, aren't you?
choice:2:0:1.male: You're all quite loyal, aren't you?
choice:2:0:1.female: You're all quite loyal, aren't you?

say:21:1421336003:1.text: Uh... W-we're not going to lie...
say:21:1421336003:1.source_cn: 呃，这、这，我们不能……不能说谎……

say:1:1421337001:1.text: Inna made it clear that pulling off this plan won't be easy, and there'll be a ton of hurdles. Everything must be kept it under wraps until it's done.
say:1:1421337001:1.source_cn: 伊娜说过，计划的实行充满了艰难险阻，在完成前，一切行动...

say:2:1421337002:1.text: The blueprint was being guarded. If she made a move for it, she'll definitely attract attention.
say:2:1421337002:1.source_cn: 伟大图纸目前被把守着，她如果想拿走图纸，就必然会引起注意！

say:3:1421337003:1.text: So, we volunteered to leave a trail and lead the pursuers to this abandoned camp here.
say:3:1421337003:1.source_cn: 所以我们自告奋勇，留下痕迹，引导追逐者到这边的废弃营地。

say:4:1421337004:1.text: Before, Inna explained her ideas and plans here. That's when we knew we had to follow her...
say:4:1421337004:1.source_cn: 过去，伊娜就在这里，我们一起听她讲述她的思路和计划……

say:5:1421337005:1.text: So, she didn't yell at you for not being able to keep up or not understanding the situation?
say:5:1421337005:1.source_cn: 她难道不会因为你们跟不上或者反应不过来，把你们痛骂一顿吗？

say:6:1421337006:1.text: I mean, what would be the point?
say:6:1421337006:1.source_cn: 呃，那、那也是她恨铁不成钢……

say:7:1421337007:1.text: Alright, let's face the facts. You're just the diversion she used to keep us busy. You probably don't know anything about her true plan.
say:7:1421337007:1.source_cn: 得了吧，你们就是被她推出来转移视线的幌子，对她的计划根...

say:8:1421337008:1.text: Do you even know where Inna is now? Do you know where she took the blueprint?
say:8:1421337008:1.source_cn: 你们除了转移视线外，知道伊娜现在在哪吗？知道她把图纸拿...

say:10:1421337010:1.text: It's time to be honest, children. Some people say obedience is a virtue, but you all are following the wrong person down the wrong path.
say:10:1421337010:1.source_cn: 孩子们，老实听话是美德，但你们跟错人，也走错方向了。

say:11:1421337011:1.text: Apologies, Magister. These children know nothing...
say:11:1421337011:1.source_cn: ……抱歉，耀光的魔法师与这位矮人女士，这几个孩子看起来...
say:11:1421337011:1.male: Apologies, Magister. These children know nothing...
say:11:1421337011:1.female: Apologies, Magister. These children know nothing...

say:12:1421337012:1.text: At this moment, a timid voice suddenly speaks.
say:12:1421337012:1.source_cn: 正当这时，一个怯怯的声音响了起来。

say:14:1421337013:1.text: Um... I-I know where Inna went... During the last meeting, I hid at the back and overheard my sister talking to her.
say:14:1421337013:1.source_cn: 那、那个，我知道伊娜她去哪儿了……上次开会的时候，我躲...

say:15:1421337014:1.text: Your sister Shirin? Oh, that's right! She's always followed Inna around!
say:15:1421337014:1.source_cn: ……你姐姐，是那个叫芝琳的？没错，她一直是伊娜的跟班！

say:16:1421337015:1.text: Yes, Shirin and Inna were talking about the <style="highlight">laboratory under the mine</style>. It's been cleaned up, and they're thinking about moving in.

say:17:1421337016:1.text: Inna said that there are a lot of ancient materials and notes worth studying there.
say:17:1421337016:1.source_cn: 伊娜则说，那里有很多古代资料和手记，很值得研究。

say:18:1421337017:1.text: She said that great things can start from such a laboratory. That's all I heard.
say:18:1421337017:1.source_cn: 她还说，伟大的事业就是要从小实验室开始，她要在那里实现...

say:20:1421337018:1.text: The three young dwarves trudge back to the village, their spirits low, while Hyla's expression remains solemn and unreadable.
say:20:1421337018:1.source_cn: 三个年轻矮人垂头丧气地回到了村子，而海拉则依然一脸凝重。

say:22:1421337019:1.text: A laboratory under the mine... How could there be a lab there? Does this have to do with those pointy-eared stonesuckers?!
say:22:1421337019:1.source_cn: 矿洞下的实验室……那儿怎么会有实验室？难道是那些尖耳朵搞的？

choice_prompt:23:1421337019.text: A laboratory under the mine... How could there be a lab there? Does this have to do with those pointy-eared stonesuckers?!
choice_prompt:23:1421337019.source_cn: 矿洞下的实验室……那儿怎么会有实验室？难道是那些尖耳朵搞的？

say:24:1421337020:1.text: I guess it's possible... Helthor's beard! I just thought of something!
say:24:1421337020:1.source_cn: 我猜就是……唉，赫托的胡子啊，这都是什么事！

say:25:1421337021:1.text: Come with me! I know where the lab is!
say:25:1421337021:1.source_cn: 跟我来吧，我知道那个实验室在哪儿。

narration:26:1421337022:1.text: Under Zanie's guidance, you all rush to her old laboratory, the urgency in her voice pushing you forward...

say:0:1421338001:0.text: By the glory of the Ironheart Dominion, outsiders are forbidden to pass!
say:0:1421338001:0.source_cn: 以钢心帝国之荣耀，外来之民，尔等禁止通行！

say:3:1421339001:1.text: Ha! Inna knew you would come!
say:3:1421339001:1.source_cn: 呵！伟大的伊娜领袖的判断果然从无错漏！

say:4:1421339002:1.text: You hateful conventionalists! I can't believe you'd let outsiders trample on the sacred land of our people. Have you no pride?
say:4:1421339002:1.source_cn: 可憎的守旧者果然引领着外来之民踏足我等矮人的圣域！

say:5:1421339003:1.text: ... Well, logically speaking, this territory actually belongs to the pointy-eared folk... Oh, never mind, pretend I didn't say anything.
say:5:1421339003:1.source_cn: ……呃，照理说这里其实应该算是尖耳朵的地盘内……算了，...

say:6:1421339004:1.text: Alright, is Inna in there? How did you find this place anyway?
say:6:1421339004:1.source_cn: 孩子们，伊娜就在里面吗？你们怎么发现的这个地方？

say:7:1421339005:1.text: The hope for revival guides us! We will rise above all!
say:7:1421339005:1.source_cn: 复兴的希望之光引领着我们，而我们将振翅腾飞！

say:8:1421339006:1.text: Inna's research has made huge strides, and it's taken our already formidable force to a whole new level of power!
say:8:1421339006:1.source_cn: 伊娜领袖的研究突飞猛进，让我们本就强大的力量更加如虎添翼！

say:9:1421339007:1.text: Let's show these blood traitors and this outsider what it means to face us!
say:9:1421339007:1.source_cn: 来吧，给这些老旧的叛徒和外来人——
say:9:1421339007:1.male: Let's show these blood traitors and this outsider what it means to face us!
say:9:1421339007:1.female: Let's show these blood traitors and this outsider what it means to face us!

say:0:1421341001:1.text: After the battle, we restrain Shirin and Bucho and turne our attention to studying the mechanical objects they had "summoned".
say:0:1421341001:1.source_cn: 战斗后，我们将芝琳与布乔制服，把他们捆到了一边，开始研...

say:2:1421341002:1.text: Oh, this is the same one as before. It's actually been repaired...
say:2:1421341002:1.source_cn: 唔，果然，这还是之前的那个，居然被修好了……

say:3:1421341003:1.text: As for this smaller one, it's a replica. Although only the rough outline is copied, the idea is very interesting.
say:3:1421341003:1.source_cn: 至于这个小点的，是复制品，虽然只复制出了个大概的轮廓，...

say:20:1421346006:1.text: Who are you calling a thief?! Eldric and you all are the thieves!
say:20:1421346006:1.source_cn: 谁是小偷！弗林还有你们才是小偷！

say:21:1421346003:1.text: Wasn't it... I don't know anything!
say:21:1421346003:1.source_cn: 什么意思，不就是图……我不知道！

choice:2:1:2.text: Are you sure you don't know?
choice:2:1:2.male: Are you sure you don't know?
choice:2:1:2.female: Are you sure you don't know?

say:1:1421347001:1.text: Once the blueprint is restored, ancient runes with distinct dwarven characteristics appear. Hyla stares at it, her expression tinged with regret
say:1:1421347001:1.source_cn: 图纸复原之后，上面呈现出了矮人特色的古代符文，海拉光是...

say:2:1421347002:1.text: It's definitely the one I lost. I deciphered a few bits here, but I can't understand the rest.
say:2:1421347002:1.source_cn: 确实是之前丢掉的那份，这里的几个部分还是我破译的，但其...

say:4:1421347003:1.text: Yeah, I get it. You're a mechanic. You didn't study history or ancient runes.
say:4:1421347003:1.source_cn: 我知道，你是搞机械的，不学历史也不学古文是吧。

say:6:1421347004:1.text: Hahaha! See! It's useless in your hands! Only someone with unparalleled intelligence like myself can understand what's written!
say:6:1421347004:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈，看不懂了吧？愚蠢！只有像我这样能够举一反三...

say:7:1421347005:1.text: Let me tell you simpletons what it says!
say:7:1421347005:1.source_cn: 让我告诉你上面写着什么吧！

say:8:1421347006:1.text: "Through endless skies, it hunts its prey. From fiery depths, it lights the way..."
say:8:1421347006:1.source_cn: 这就是：万里逐敌之弓！渊底流焰凝结之弓，伟大而闪耀的——

say:10:1421347008:1.text: How did you know that, you little runt?!
say:10:1421347008:1.source_cn: 杜恩——咳咳咳，你、你这个小丫头，你怎么认识？！

say:12:1421347009:1.text: Not only do I understand the runes, but I also recognize the seals at the bottom—the Grand Artificer's writ and Helthor's decree.
say:12:1421347009:1.source_cn: 我不但认识这些文字，还认识最下方的盖章——皇家大工程师...

say:14:1421347010:1.text: Was that the leader of the Ironheart Dominion?
say:14:1421347010:1.source_cn: 那是帝国时期的负责人吗？

say:15:1421347011:1.text: Yes, the dwarves of the Dominion did not have such a clear division of labor back then. Many were generalists and versatile in their work.
say:15:1421347011:1.source_cn: 是的，帝国时期的矮人还没有这样明确的分工，很多人都是多面手。

say:16:1421347012:1.text: The Grand Artificer wasn't merely an engineer. This individual was in charge of material and resource allocation, forging, energy supply, blueprint design, land modification, and so much more.
say:16:1421347012:1.source_cn: 皇家大工程师并不只是工程师，而是能够把控材料、锻冶、能...

say:17:1421347013:1.text: Just as the legends say, Helthor is a god skilled in all dwarven crafts, perfected to the highest degree. The Grand Artificer was known as Helthor's representative on the material plane.
say:17:1421347013:1.source_cn: 就像传说中赫托就是擅长矮人诸多技艺，无一不精的神明一样...

say:19:1421347014:1.text: Proficient across so many fields... Was there truly such a person? That's incredible.
say:19:1421347014:1.source_cn: 能横跨这么多的学科，每一种都无比擅长……真的有这样的人...

say:20:1421347015:1.text: Yes, this was the essence of the Dominion! Now, dwarves study design but neglect material processing. They forge but have no hand in design. We've fallen so far!
say:20:1421347015:1.source_cn: 这、这就是帝国的底蕴！现在的矮人，学了设计就不学材料，...

say:21:1421347016:1.text: Well, I'm not going to comment on your point of view... That said, if you're interested in learning more about the Grand Artificer, I know a bit.
say:21:1421347016:1.source_cn: 唔，你的这个观点我无法评价……总之，先说大工程师的事吧。

say:22:1421347017:1.text: To my knowledge, this was the last Grand Artificer recorded in the Dominion. He personally named the Eclipsion and wrote this description.
say:22:1421347017:1.source_cn: 据我所知，这是帝国最后一任有记载的工程师，他亲自为杜恩...

say:23:1421347018:1.text: There are tons of records about this person and the Eclipsion all over the place. But the ones in my family's documents? Those are the juiciest—super detailed since he's my ancestor.
say:23:1421347018:1.source_cn: 在许多地方都留下了各类记载，尤其是我家传的文件上，相关...

say:24:1421347019:1.text: Without those files, no way I could've led Indris and <style="stress"><player_name></style> straight to the Eclipsion in that lost temple.
say:24:1421347019:1.source_cn: 若非如此，我当时也无法那么准确地引领<style=st...
say:24:1421347019:1.male: Without those files, no way I could've led Indris and <style="stress"><player_name></style> straight to the Eclipsion in that lost temple.
say:24:1421347019:1.female: Without those files, no way I could've led Indris and <style="stress"><player_name></style> straight to the Eclipsion in that lost temple.

say:25:1421347020:1.text: But this blueprint is priceless... It's the final version before submission and production. Even I've never laid eyes on an original until now.
say:25:1421347020:1.source_cn: 但这份图确实很珍贵……应该是提交投产前的最终设计图版本...

say:26:1421347021:1.text: W-what did you just say? He's an ancestor of yours?
say:26:1421347021:1.source_cn: 你、你说什么？这个伟大的工程师是，是你的祖先？

say:27:1421347022:1.text: Yes, you little runt. I've lived a lot longer than you can imagine, and I've read countless records of that age...
say:27:1421347022:1.source_cn: 是的，小丫头，我活得比你想象得久得多，也阅读过无数的史...

say:28:1421347023:1.text: Of all those living today, perhaps I am the closest witness to the rise and fall of the Dominion you so desire to emulate.
say:28:1421347023:1.source_cn: 在如今生者之中，或许我是距离你所向往的帝国兴盛与毁灭的...

say:29:1421347024:1.text: With Hyla and Inna utterly dumbfounded, Zanie begins to recount, with earnest sincerity, the same story she told us in Sal'thorin.
say:29:1421347024:1.source_cn: 在海拉与伊娜目瞪口呆的注视下，祖娅认真地讲述了在萨洛克...

say:30:1421347025:1.text: She speaks of the Dominion's arrogance, the change in Helthor, and the greed that led to the exploitation of innocent lives...
say:30:1421347025:1.source_cn: 帝国的傲慢，赫托的变化，对无辜生命的贪婪与利用……

say:31:1421347026:1.text: She recounts how the dwarves lost their humanity and allowed desire to fester like poison within the Dominion—until the dragon's curse sealed its fate.
say:31:1421347026:1.source_cn: 失去了敬畏，失去了人性，任由欲望如毒火般无穷无尽蔓延的...

say:32:1421347027:1.text: Inna... Seeing you reminds me of when I was young.
say:32:1421347027:1.source_cn: ……伊娜，看到你的样子，我就想起年轻时的我。

say:33:1421347028:1.text: Oh, I was your age back then, before I drank the egg essence. Naive, smart, and way too cocky—sound familiar?
say:33:1421347028:1.source_cn: 我那时没有喝下蛋液，正是你现在的年纪。我天真，聪明，而...

say:34:1421347029:1.text: Turns out, my cockiness is why I couldn't handle the fact that all my so-called achievements were based on something so... horrid.
say:34:1421347029:1.source_cn: 但，正因为我如此傲慢，我才无法接受，我一切的成果都建立...

say:36:1421347031:1.text: However, I know that if you knew the truth, you'd be as resolute as I am...
say:36:1421347031:1.source_cn: 但我知道，你只要知道真相，就一定会和我一样，下定决心。

say:38:1421347033:1.text: Perhaps you still need a little more time... Hyla, why don't you take her and her friends back to the village to rest?
say:38:1421347033:1.source_cn: 或许你还需要点时间……海拉，带着她和她的那些伙伴们，回...

say:40:1421347034:1.text: Clearly devastated, Inna follows Hyla out of the lab in silence, her usual defiance replaced by uncharacteristic obedience.
say:40:1421347034:1.source_cn: 大概是彻底崩溃了，伊娜十分老实地跟着海拉离开了实验室。

say:41:1421347035:1.text: Zanie, on the other hand, looks at the lab and lets out a heavy sigh...
say:41:1421347035:1.source_cn: 而祖娅，则望着实验室长叹了一声……

say:43:1421347036:1.text: Perhaps now I can tell you why I'm here.
say:43:1421347036:1.source_cn: ……呃，所以，现在我可以说我的来意了吗？

say:2:1421348001:1.text: That young lady was so noisy that I almost forgot to tell you.
say:2:1421348001:1.source_cn: 那个小姑娘太吵了，我差点忘记了有事来找你们。

say:3:1421348002:1.text: We were going through the various historical documents at the Temple of Helthor, and we found what looks like a series of plans.
say:3:1421348002:1.source_cn: 我们之前重新整理赫托神殿里留下的各种历史文件，发现了一...

say:4:1421348003:1.text: Everything is encrypted in ancient dwarven runes, so we couldn't read it. I brought the most complete copy for Zanie to examine.
say:4:1421348003:1.source_cn: 也是用的这种古代矮人符文加密，我们无法识别。我带了看起...

say:5:1421348004:1.source_cn: 神殿里留下的文件，还是用的矮人符文加密？系列计划书？

say:6:1421348005:1.source_cn: 奇怪，怎么会有这种东西，拿来我看看。

say:7:1421348006:1.text: Zanie takes the documents from Indris' hands, and her eyes widen the moment she reads the title.
say:7:1421348006:1.source_cn: 祖娅没精打采地从因度厄手里拿过那本文件，但在看到标题的...

say:8:1421348007:1.text: She flips through the pages with such intensity it nearly tears them apart. Her expression shifts with every page, shock etched deeply into her face.
say:8:1421348007:1.source_cn: 她以一种不惜破坏文件的力度快速地翻阅着文件的内容，脸色...

say:9:1421348008:1.text: Helthor's beard... I can't believe this...
say:9:1421348008:1.source_cn: 这……这是……原来如此……这里居然是……赫托在下……

choice_prompt:10:1421348008.text: Helthor's beard... I can't believe this...
choice_prompt:10:1421348008.source_cn: 这……这是……原来如此……这里居然是……赫托在下……

say:11:1421348009:1.text: Things I've never even realized... The things that I was wrong about. There's also information that could save Brimstone Village!
say:11:1421348009:1.source_cn: 写了一些连我都不知道……连我都搞错了的事情，还有能拯救...

say:12:1421348011:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go back to Brimstone Village! I have to tell them what I found here!
say:12:1421348011:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go back to Brimstone Village! I have to tell them what I found here!
say:12:1421348011:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go back to Brimstone Village! I have to tell them what I found here!

say:13:1421348012:1.text: And, Indris, please run an errand for me! I need you to go to where the dragon eggs were being mined.
say:13:1421348012:1.source_cn: 还有，因度厄，拜托你帮我跑趟腿！就去，就去之前开采龙蛋...

say:14:1421348013:1.text: There should be a kind of ore that doesn't really look like the others, and it has several different characteristics... Oh, forget it, I'll just write it down for you!
say:14:1421348013:1.source_cn: 那里应该有某种矿石，长得不一定一样，但是大概有这些特征...

say:15:1421348014:1.text: As soon as you find it, contact me on the communicator. This is very important and very urgent!
say:15:1421348014:1.source_cn: 麻烦你尽快去确认一下，一旦发现，就用通讯器联络我，拜托...

say:17:1421348016:1.text: Once Zanie has written everything down and hands her notes to Indris, she hurries off, rushing back to Brimstone Village with urgency...
say:17:1421348016:1.source_cn: 祖娅火急火燎地安排后，又急不可耐地朝深岩村冲去……

say:19:1421348010:1.text: Yes, very important! There's information here that could save Brimstone Village!
say:19:1421348010:1.source_cn: 没错，非常重要！这里写了一些连我都不得而知的东西，其中...

say:0:1421349001:0.text: Strange... I wonder what Zanie is looking for in such a hurry...
say:0:1421349001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，祖娅到底要找什么东西，这么着急……
say:0:1421349001:0.male: Strange... I wonder what Zanie is looking for in such a hurry...
say:0:1421349001:0.female: Strange... I wonder what Zanie is looking for in such a hurry...

say:0:1421350001:0.text: The villagers look listless. Let's find Hyla first. She should be at the workshop with Inna.
say:0:1421350001:0.source_cn: 村人看起来更没精神了，先去找海拉吧，她应该和伊娜在工坊。
say:0:1421350001:0.male: The villagers look listless. Let's find Hyla first. She should be at the workshop with Inna.
say:0:1421350001:0.female: The villagers look listless. Let's find Hyla first. She should be at the workshop with Inna.

say:1:1421353001:1.text: So, what do you want with me? Are you going to keep attacking me and my beliefs?
say:1:1421353001:1.source_cn: 所以，你们找我有何贵干？想继续辱骂我曾经的信仰吗？

choice_prompt:2:1421353001.text: So, what do you want with me? Are you going to keep attacking me and my beliefs?
choice_prompt:2:1421353001.source_cn: 所以，你们找我有何贵干？想继续辱骂我曾经的信仰吗？

say:3:1421353002:1.text: Don't tell me it's another boring piece of relic... Whatever, I'll take a look.
say:3:1421353002:1.source_cn: 好啊，又是什么无聊的罪恶的东西？我看就是了。

say:4:1421353004:1.text: You should be able to understand the beginning of the document. Read it for yourself.
say:4:1421353004:1.source_cn: ……你应该也能看懂这份文件的开头，你自己读吧。

say:5:1421353005:1.text:
Alright, hand it here.
"Helthor's... Brimstone Workshop, 8th batch of the 14th production cycle..."
say:5:1421353005:1.source_cn: 读就读。\n赫托及……深岩工坊，某年第8批第14号线锻造……

say:6:1421353006:1.text: "Full echorite manufacturing of the battle longbow—version EP04..." What is this?!
say:6:1421353006:1.source_cn: 全精深岩晶制造主战长弓EP04……这，这写的什么东西？！

say:8:1421353007:1.text: Look at the writing at the bottom.
say:8:1421353007:1.source_cn: 来，看这里，最下面的手写。

say:9:1421353008:1.text: "Version number cannot be shared with external stakeholders. Temporary codename—<style="highlight">Eclipsion</style>?!"
say:9:1421353008:1.source_cn: 版本号起名无法对外，临时赋用代号——<style=hi...

say:11:1421353009:1.text: Inna stares at Zanie in disbelief while Zanie calmly flips to another page of the documents.
say:11:1421353009:1.source_cn: 伊娜难以置信地抬头看向祖娅，而祖娅平静地再次翻开了这份文件。

say:12:1421353010:1.text: You asked what this is... You and Hyla should be very familiar with it.
say:12:1421353010:1.source_cn: 刚刚你问的这写的什么东西……你和海拉主管，都应该很熟悉才是。

say:13:1421353011:1.text: Helthor, our god, was the master designer who made this weapon.
say:13:1421353011:1.source_cn: 赫托，伟大的神明，是这份武器的主设计师和主负责人。

say:14:1421353012:1.text: Brimstone Workshop was his primary production plant. It was also the heart of operations, where Helthor's supervisor managed all production and design.
say:14:1421353012:1.source_cn: 深岩工坊，是它主要出产的工厂和生产线名称，也是赫托主管...

say:15:1421353013:1.text: A specific year isn't mentioned, but the "8th batch of the 14th production cycle" refers to the manufacturing of special creations under that year's production directives.
say:15:1421353013:1.source_cn: 年份就不提了，第8批第14号线，代表本年度批次下的第1...

say:16:1421353014:1.text: "Version EP04" represents the fourth iteration of what was designed and crafted.
say:16:1421353014:1.source_cn: 而EP04，则代表着是迭代后的第四版本。

say:17:1421353015:1.text: During weapon iteration, the most representative version is selected from the best models and then modified for improvement...
say:17:1421353015:1.source_cn: 在迭代武器的时候，会从版本中优中选优选出最有代表性的一...

say:18:1421353016:1.text: So, the Eclipsion was simply a template used to determine the next iteration from numerous batches?
say:18:1421353016:1.source_cn: 所以，杜恩加尔，只是诸多批次版本中择选出下次迭代的模板？

say:19:1421353017:1.text: Exactly. What this naming process proves is that...
say:19:1421353017:1.source_cn: 正是。这个命名方式能够证明的是……

say:20:1421353018:1.text: ...the Ironheart Dominion you're so obsessed with, Inna, was not an ancient land of perfection and tradition.
say:20:1421353018:1.source_cn: 伊娜，你所向往的钢心帝国，并不是充斥着传统与诗歌的古老国度。

say:21:1421353019:1.text: Right before the Dominion fell apart, the generalist engineers were already on their way out. They saw the writing on the wall.
say:21:1421353019:1.source_cn: 甚至在帝国覆灭前夕，无所不精的多面手工程师也在慢慢退出舞台。

say:22:1421353020:1.text: During the age of ancient gods and empires, the dwarves were already exploring the division of labor, specialization, and the creation of standardized production processes.
say:22:1421353020:1.source_cn: 在神明临世，帝国长存的古老年代，矮人们就已经开始尝试分...

say:23:1421353021:1.text: They developed methods to mass-produce these artifacts. Even divine power and magic were controlled through machinery. The dwarves were carving their own path.
say:23:1421353021:1.source_cn: 并且探索着，能够批量生产所谓神器，连神力与魔力都为机械...

say:24:1421353022:1.text: But what's the difference between this and our current manufacturing and production lines?
say:24:1421353022:1.source_cn: 这，这和我们现在的工厂和生产线有什么区别？

say:25:1421353023:1.source_cn: ……没有区别。正是因为没有区别！

say:26:1421353024:1.text: We've actually been walking on the same broken path... No, <style="highlight">this path was never broken</style>. It was always the same.
say:26:1421353024:1.source_cn: 所以，我们其实一直走在曾经一度断绝……不，或许<sty...

say:27:1421353025:1.text: All the gods had betrayed us. Our empire gone... But sin will eventually be washed away by time.
say:27:1421353025:1.source_cn: 神明背叛了我们，帝国覆灭……罪孽终究会被时光冲刷。

say:28:1421353026:1.text: In the face of any harsh environment, we dwarves persevere, driven by an unyielding spirit of innovation—and, yes, a touch of arrogance.
say:28:1421353026:1.source_cn: 但，我们矮人无论身处怎样的环境，始终踏实肯干，不断升级...

say:29:1421353027:1.text: Over the centuries, this path was never broken. It was passed on to us.
say:29:1421353027:1.source_cn: 多年以来，从未断绝，始终被我们传承着。

say:30:1421353028:1.text:
...
But what is the purpose of this spirit of innovation? What does it truly serve?
say:30:1421353028:1.source_cn: ………………\n但，我们要这些所谓的精神有什么用？

say:31:1421353029:1.text: Zanie doesn't answer directly. Instead, she pulls out a weapon she had crafted specifically for the dragon and hands it to Inna.
say:31:1421353029:1.source_cn: 祖娅没有直接回答，只是掏出了一样东西——是之前她特别制...

say:32:1421353030:1.text: Inna gives her a puzzled look but is quickly drawn to the intriguing structure of the weapon. After a moment, she looks up, her curiosity piqued.
say:32:1421353030:1.source_cn: 伊娜疑惑地看了她一眼，但立刻就被这有趣的结构所吸引，过...

say:33:1421353031:1.text: If I'm not mistaken, the lead here utilizes magic infusion, which allows for faster, more precise, and more powerful effects compared to standard mechanical firing.
say:33:1421353031:1.source_cn: 我没看错的话，这里的引线使用了魔力注入，从而能产生比一...

say:34:1421353032:1.text: So, why not add the same structure to this section?
say:34:1421353032:1.source_cn: 但要是这样，为什么不在这一部分再增加同样的结构呢？

say:35:1421353033:1.text: Honestly, when I first designed it, I wasn't sure I'd find a mage who'd be willing to pump magic into it the way I wanted.
say:35:1421353033:1.source_cn: 因为在设计之初，我还不确定能不能找到按照我的标准愿意为...

say:36:1421353034:1.text: Take a closer look, and you'll see that the trigger conditions for the magic are extremely strict. The mage has to be crazy precise with their magic in order for it to work.
